calls.thesis: Buying opportunity on the dip with relatively HIGH conviction. Down >20% in 2026. Forward PE 14.5 (lowest in years); DCF fair value $241 vs $189 (~27% upside 12-18mo). Thesis: pandemic pulled demand forward + weak disposable income are near-term headwinds; structural position in $1T home-improvement industry unchanged; growth re-accelerates to mid-high single digits when economy normalizes. Bear: operating margin fell to 11.3% from 15%+ (wage pressure), AI productivity gains only incremental.
calls.bull_case: Normalized economy + deferred projects return; mid-high single-digit growth resumes.
calls.bear_case: Headwinds persist through most of 2027; margins stay compressed on wage inflation.
